William, I'm sorry. Your Harlo B30 was due to ship on November 14 and it hasn't. That date was ours and we missed it.

The B30 stock hasn't reached our US warehouse yet. Your free Power Kit is already there, set aside for you, and it'll go in the same box as the B30.

I'm getting the new ship date confirmed. The team is offline right now. They'll pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET and email the answer to the address on your order. You don't need to wait here.

To see where the B30 shipment is on its way to us, check https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
